caption: The drawing displays a rectangular piece of fabric with a sampler embroidery design, featuring a decorative border composed of alternating red floral motifs and green leafy vines. At the top, there is a block of text stitched in dark thread, with upper and lower case alphabet letters and numbers beneath it, separated by small motif bands—one of which has birds, a small house, and flowerpots. Towards the top right, a basket of flowers is stitched in yellow and red, with green leaves. The central part of the embroidery depicts a symmetrical red brick house with a yellow-brown door and blue-framed windows, set on a dark green patch suggesting grass. Flanking the house are large plants with red flowers, green stems, and leaves. The border continues along all four sides and frames the entire composition. Additionally, there is a small rectangular swatch below the embroidery, featuring a segment of the same floral and vine pattern found in the main border, using red and green thread on a tan fabric background.
title: Sampler
